explanation: Final exact source freeze review found no remaining safety or integration defects. The previously identified missing client helpers, unbound prepare allocation, stale post-prepare terms/banner, absent clean-state fixed review choices, and terminal authorization term reuse were all corrected before the final frozen hashes; canonical prepared-5 choices now preserve fixed purpose, lifetime, stop rules, FINAL_CONFIRMATION/86400, and no authority or consent.

resolved_findings.evidence: axiom/ui/app.js restores terminalAction and actionResponseStatus before all callers.
axiom/operator.py binds proposed_allocation from the prepared selection before validation and response construction.
axiom/ui/app.js marks the main terms grid and updates it from fresh GET data after prepare.
axiom/ui/app.js updates and hides data-review-missing from fresh reviewValues.
axiom/operator.py exploratory_live_review_choices and dashboard bounded projection provide canonical fixed terms after verified prepared5.
axiom/operator.py replaces all review terms and clears expires_at for prepared5 when authorization is non-DRAFT/non-ACTIVE.

safety_invariants: prepare is explicit exploratory.live.prepare with exact confirmation and empty payload
prepare returns paper-only PREPARED state and does not activate authority, persist consent, or submit orders
prepared proposal pointer/hash/member bindings remain immutable and repeated prepare reuses the same prepared row
terminal authorization expiry, purpose, lifetime, stop rules, approval, acknowledgment, and bindings are not reused for a new prepared5 review
bounded ui-state reads canonical fixed choices without invoking the full review snapshot
client consumes POST only for terminal status and reloads authoritative bounded terms
